disclaimer: Process and turnaround data verified June 2026; tiers, prices, and backlogs move — always confirm on the linked official pages before shipping cards.

psaSteps.detail: A free PSA account (Collectors.com login) is required for the Online Submission Center. A paid Collectors Club membership is NOT required for most retail tiers — it's required only for Value Bulk and unlocks member pricing (~$99/yr entry historically with a grading voucher (est.), up to $149 Standard / $199 Premium).
On the online form (psacard.com/submit), the service level sets your price and turnaround. As of mid-June 2026, all four Value tiers are paused — Regular (~$79.99/card) is the cheapest open path.
Year, set, card number, character/player, and variation for every card, in the order you will stack them.

DV is your estimate of the card's value AFTER grading and acts as PSA's insurance cap. Each tier has a max DV ceiling (Value ~$499; Regular ~$1,499–$1,500; Express and up higher). If a card grades higher than expected and its market value exceeds the tier cap, PSA upcharges/bumps it to a higher tier and bills the difference — pick a tier whose cap covers the realistic graded value.

Available on Value Plus and higher (the base Value tier does not offer it). Cards below your minimum come back ungraded/raw or as 'PSA Authentic' — but the full fee still applies. With Value tiers paused, the cheapest tier offering minimum-grade is Regular.
Penny sleeve + Card Saver I per card, stacked in exact form order — see packaging rules. Non-compliant holders trigger a 5% processing-and-handling penalty.

Sturdy box (never just an envelope) to PSA's California facility — the address prints on your packing slip. Use a tracked, insured carrier (USPS Registered/Priority, UPS, FedEx) and insure for your total declared value: PSA does not insure your package in transit TO them; their liability begins only at 'Order Prep'.

Order Arrived/Received → Order Prep (PSA liability and the turnaround clock start here) → Research & ID → Grading (longest stage) → Assembly (encapsulation) → Quality Assurance → Awaiting Accounting Release → Shipped.
Grading fees are pre-paid at submission; return shipping + insurance (scaled to declared value) is billed at completion before the order ships. You can view grades in 'My Orders' before release.

packagingRules: Penny sleeve first — clear, never opaque — then a Card Saver I semi-rigid holder (Card Saver II for thicker cards). Card Saver, NOT a toploader.
Prohibited: toploaders, screw-downs, magnetic/snap cases, tape, tabs, sticky notes, and writing on holders — any of these triggers a 5% processing-and-handling penalty on the order.
Stack cards in the exact order listed on the submission form, Item #1 on top.
Sandwich the stack between two pieces of cardboard and secure with 2–3 rubber bands.
Ship in a sturdy box, not an envelope, via a tracked and insured carrier, insured for the full total declared value.

delayGuidance: The pause is real and still in effect: effective June 2, 2026, PSA temporarily paused all four Value tiers (Value Bulk, Value, Value Plus, Value Max) after a ~20% submission surge pushed the active backlog to nearly 10 million cards.

PSA's stated plan: reopen Value tiers once the backlog drops from ~10M to 5M cards, projected to take up to ~4 months — a tentative reopening window around Q3–Q4 2026 (~October). This is PSA's projection, not a guarantee.
PSA launched a public monthly Backlog Tracker and extended existing Collectors Club memberships to compensate for the pause — watch the tracker before planning a bulk submission.

Practical math: a 10-card lot that would have been Value is now ~$800 minimum at Regular before shipping (~$85–95/card all-in). For sub-$200 cards, the rational moves are: hold and pre-grade with the Grade Lab until Value reopens, use a group submitter for dealer pricing, or pick an alternative grader.
'Switch graders' is not a clean escape: the whole industry hit capacity within days in late May 2026 — TAG closed Express/Basic/Standard, and CGC turnaround stretched to ~65–120 working days.

Group submissions (PSA Authorized Dealers / online submitters like Bent Cardboard, Level Up Subs, CollectorStore, CardsHQ, Filthbomb) let you skip the $99+ Collectors Club membership and access bulk/dealer pricing, often at or below PSA's retail single-card rate (magnitude varies, est.). Risks: third-party custody (loss/theft/mix-ups), the dealer's declared value and insurance governs, batch-fill delays, possible service markups, and the same open-tier constraints during the pause. Use established submitters and get written terms on insurance, DV, fees, and timing.

alternatives.whenToUse: Cheapest published bulk/economy sticker price; good for modern/Pokémon volume when PSA Value is paused and you can wait.
alternatives.costTurnaround: Bulk $17 / Economy $20 / Standard $55 / Express $100 / Walkthrough $300; members save 10–20%. Mid-2026 actual: Economy ~65 working days, Bulk ~120 working days (est., congested).
alternatives.resaleTradeoff: CGC slabs generally sell below PSA for vintage and most sports, closer to PSA for modern Pokémon — savings can be eaten by lower resale.

alternatives.whenToUse: Speed and transparency when slots are open — AI-assisted grading with a detailed digital report card; best for personal-collection cards or modern you'll hold.
alternatives.costTurnaround: Express $59 (~45+ biz days, reopening at a lower price), Priority $149 (~5 days), Walkthrough $299 (~2–3 days); Economy ~$12–15 when open (est.). Fastest of the group when open (~15–30 biz days), but Express/Basic/Standard were closed in late May 2026.
alternatives.resaleTradeoff: Smallest secondary-market footprint of the four — resale liquidity and premiums lag PSA significantly.

alternatives.whenToUse: Modern high-end chase cards where a BGS 9.5 Gem / Black Label 10 with sub-grades carries a premium; no-membership convenience and free sub-grades (centering/corners/edges/surface) on every card.
alternatives.costTurnaround: Economy $22 (DV ≤ $499) / Standard $34.95 (~45 days) / Express $79.95 (~15 days) / Priority $124.95 (~5 days). Actual Economy currently ~60–120 calendar days (est., congested).
alternatives.resaleTradeoff: Black Label and 9.5s can rival or beat PSA on select modern; mid-grade BGS generally trails PSA.

alternatives.service: Group submission via a PSA Authorized Dealer
alternatives.whenToUse: You want PSA slabs at bulk/dealer pricing without the Collectors Club membership, and can tolerate handing your cards to a third party and waiting for a batch to fill.
alternatives.costTurnaround: Often at or below PSA's own retail single-card rate, sometimes meaningfully less (magnitude varies by shop, est.); longer effective timeline since dealers wait to fill batches, plus the same open-tier constraints during the pause.
alternatives.resaleTradeoff: No resale tradeoff — you end up with full-premium PSA slabs; the tradeoff is custody risk and the dealer's DV/insurance terms governing instead of yours.
